hypothesis: Compare a fitted log-price level at the selected expiry against the actual entry quote; do not translate the entire forecast to eliminate its current residual.
singleChange: expectedLogMove = selected.predict(horizonMs/1000), replacing selected.predict(horizonMs/1000)-selected.predict(0). Both baseline and wide searches share this change.
development: Previously inspected 15 Forex and 9 crypto windows; their results are development only.

validationRegisteredBeforeOutcomes.source: Official Binance 1s OHLC closing observations at second completion; not broker OTC.
validationRegisteredBeforeOutcomes.rule: Freeze the single formula change. Evaluate all complete windows; do not tune after seeing validation. Report all windows, ties, coverage, corrected/spoiled entries and latency. Improvement on development alone is insufficient.

acceptance: Require a positive paired change in completed 30s outcomes on both known markets and separately on validation, no new entry wait, no changed active-window direction, and no production changes. Any improvement remains external evidence, not validated OTC performance.
